title: Holistic Diversity Management in LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.38407v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search iteratively selects existing programs, uses LLMs as mutation operators to generate a new program, and evaluates it to guide subsequent search. To preserve diversity and reduce the risk of premature convergence, it often adopts the island model, in which groups of programs, called islands, evolve separately. However, this structure alone does not guarantee distinct search directions, as islands may start from similar programs or converge toward similar solutions during evolution. This suggests that diversity must be considered throughout the search process, from initializing islands with distinct programs to developing island trajectories and sharing discoveries across islands. To this end, we propose HoliDivEvolve , a holistic approach to establishing and effectively utilizing island diversity throughout evolutionary search. translated_title: LLM引导的进化搜索中的整体多样性管理
translated_abstract: LLM引导的进化搜索迭代地选择现有程序，将大语言模型（LLM）用作变异算子来生成新程序，并对其进行评估以指导后续搜索。为了保持多样性并降低过早收敛的风险，这类方法通常采用岛屿模型，即让被称为“岛屿”的程序组各自独立进化。然而，仅靠这种结构并不能保证不同的搜索方向，因为各个岛屿可能从相似的程序起步，或者在进化过程中收敛到相似的解。这表明多样性必须在整个搜索过程中被加以考虑，从用不同的程序初始化各个岛屿，到发展各岛屿的搜索轨迹，再到跨岛屿共享发现。为此，我们提出了HoliDivEvolve，这是一种在进化搜索全过程中建立并有效利用岛屿多样性的整体方法。具体而言，我们引入了多样化初始化来建立不同的初始……
tldr: 提出HoliDivEvolve方法，通过多样化初始化、岛屿轨迹发展和跨岛屿发现共享，在LLM引导的进化搜索全过程中建立并有效利用岛屿多样性，以避免过早收敛。
en_tdlr: Proposes HoliDivEvolve, a holistic approach that establishes and effectively utilizes island diversity throughout LLM-guided evolutionary search—from diverse initialization to island trajectory development and cross-island discovery sharing—to mitigate premature convergence.
